name: Locusts
overview: Scripture presents locusts both as a part of God's created order and as instruments of His judgment. They are described as numerous and powerful creatures that come forth in bands without a king, demonstrating God's sovereign control over even the smallest details of creation (Proverbs 30:27; Psalms 105:34). Locusts also appear in the context of divine plagues and destruction, as seen in the hardening of Pharaoh's heart and the subsequent plague in Exodus 10:1, and in the devastating agricultural damage described in Joel 1:4. Yet, God promises restoration from the devastation caused by locusts, highlighting His mercy and redemptive power (Joel 2:25). Additionally, locusts are permitted as clean food in Leviticus 11:22, showing their place within God's provision for His people.
